svg.aria-label: One SM of an H100, divided into 4 processing blocks. Each has its own control logic, 32 arithmetic units drawn as small squares, and 16,384 registers. Below the 4 processing blocks, one pool of 256 KB serves as shared memory and L1 cache for the whole SM.
svg.text: Inside one SM of an H100
4 processing blocks of 32 arithmetic units, each with its own control logic.
shared memory and L1 cache: 256 KB, used by all 4 processing blocks
holds up to 2,048 threads: 64 warps, 16 per processing block
2,048 threads / 128 arithmetic units = 16 threads for each unit
